about: The introitus of the formulary “21st Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: All things, O Lord, are set within Your will, and there is none who can withstand Your will; for it is You who made everything, heaven and earth, and all things held within the circuit of heaven: You are Lord of all. Blessed are the spotless in the way, who walk in the law of the Lord. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
